<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex400122026-09-1602-45-28" status="unreviewed"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4264">gnyags</rs> na re nyan thos bye brag du smra ba dang mdo' ste ma gas drug po
            'das ma thag pa'i yid la yid kyi khaMs su 'dod pa na de na shes kyi tshogs drug la la
            logs pa lnga pas bye brag du smra ba khaMs bcu' bdun rdzas su yod par 'dod pa la mdo'
            sde bas khas phyed dang bcu' bun rdzas su yod par 'dod do || <lb edRef="inst:4749" n="26b6"/> drug pa'i
            gnas la thag pa'i || na shes gang yin te yid do || dug pa'i rten ni rab sgrub kyis ||
            khas ni bcos myed dag du 'dod || ces bshad paso | | zhes zer ro | | </seg></TEI>
